resources.string: Sadar kasta oo la calaamadeeyay in la oggolaado, taabo badhanka oo aqbal. Halkan ku soo noqo kadib: sadarku wuu cusboonaysiin.
Haddii taleefanku diido helitaanka: fur macluumaadka app-ka SENTIA, taabo saddexda dhibcood ee midig sare, dooro Oggolow goobaha xaddidan, kadibna mar kale isku day.

1. Shid adeegga helitaanka SENTIA. Haddii la diido: macluumaadka app-ka, saddex dhibcood, Oggolow goobaha xaddidan.\n2. Haddii Codka kor saddex jeer uusan shaqayn: dami oo mar kale shid adeegga helitaanka.

1. Goobaha, Abbaarayaasha, SENTIA, Badbaadiyaha batariga: dooro Xaddid la’aan.\n2. Goobaha, Abbaarayaasha, Ogolaanshaha, Bilow toos ah: shid SENTIA.\n3. Abbaarayaasha dhawaan: ku sii hay SENTIA, kadibna taabo quful.

1. Goobaha, Abbaarayaasha, SENTIA, Batari: dooro Xaddid la’aan.
2. Goobaha, Batari, Xadka isticmaalka gadaasha: dami Seexi abbaarayaasha aan la isticmaalin, kadibna ku dar SENTIA Abbaarayaasha aan weligood seexan.
3. Abbaarayaasha dhawaan: taabo astaanta SENTIA, kadibna Furan ku hay.
4. Helitaanka: Goobaha, Helitaanka, Abbaarayaasha la rakibay, SENTIA.
